03 / A TOOLKIT THAT RESPECTS YOU

Your career is personal.
It should stay yours.

Thoughtful defaults. Clear boundaries.
Built to help you make your own decisions.

Look under the hood ↗
01

Evidence before confidence.

Review sources, correct claims and see what’s still unknown. Recovery routes are possibilities to test, not hireability predictions.

02

Local first. Deliberately.

The app runs on your computer. Recovery sessions start in memory; disk saving is optional. The job-search workspace saves its files locally.

03

AI on your terms.

Core recovery works without AI. Optional recovery AI review needs configuration, an exact payload preview and your consent. Workspace AI has separate settings.

04

Open by design.

MIT-licensed code you can read, adapt and contribute to. No subscription is required; optional AI providers may charge for usage.

A FEW THINGS YOU MIGHT BE WONDERING

Good questions.
Straight answers.

Still curious? Ask a setup question or report an issue on GitHub ↗

Who is ReboundOps for?+

Experienced software professionals navigating a layoff, exploring a career change or trying to bring structure to their next move. It is a self-directed toolkit, not a recruitment agency or a promise of employment.

Do I need to pay or use an AI model?+

The code is free under the MIT license. The core recovery flow needs no API key. Optional AI features require a separately configured provider and may incur provider charges.

Is this a hosted app?+

This website introduces the project. The recovery app and job-search workspace run on your own computer. Follow the setup instructions below to start the integrated local workspace.

Where does my information go?+

Recovery sessions are memory-only by default, with optional unencrypted local disk saving and downloadable backups. Workspace CVs, reports and tracker data are local files. Configured AI features can send data to a provider; recovery AI review requires a separate payload preview and consent. This marketing site has no analytics, account signup or data collection form.

Will it apply to jobs for me?+

No. It helps you explore, prepare and organize. You decide which opportunities to pursue and submit your own applications.

How mature is the project?+

ReboundOps is an early local developer preview with automated engineering checks. External participant validation, independent accessibility evaluation and live recovery AI evaluation remain open. Feedback is welcome; career outcomes are not guaranteed.
